column1: # Agent tools with no marketplace or official installer, built from a pinned upstream revision by
#   name     the command linked into the bin directory
#   kind     node (npm build) or python (a venv with the package installed)
#   rev      the pinned commit (a full SHA: tags can move)
#   subdir   the package's directory in the repository, or . for its root
#   patches  a directory of our own patches applied in order with git am, or -
#   audit    fix: run `npm audit fix` (in-range only) before building; - to build the lockfile as is
# Bump a pin by changing rev (and the matching plugin's UPSTREAM.md and manifests), then run
